truth_source: JPL SBDB API (ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api, phys-par: spec_B, spec_T) for objects https://spherex-planet-x.bodhishanbhag.workers.dev/api/objects reports as JPL-identified
method_plain: Real check: for every object JPL identified, its published taxonomy class (SMASSII spec_B preferred, else Tholen spec_T, from JPL's Small-Body Database) is reduced to its complex and compared with our best complex. Simulated check: every Bus-DeMeo class mean, varied within its class spread, is sampled at each real object's bands with that object's real errors, and classified the same way.
